device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, external IR sensor / 4-digit LED eye, and USB PVR
device.board: 20020A88 (bootloader version "M3510B 1.1.1", 128 MB DDR3 M3503 revision B platform)
device.soc: ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU DVB-S2 SoC reading chip ID 0x3503 rev 0x0001; NIM_S3503_0, DMX_S3601_0/2, DECV_AVC_0, DECV_AVS_0, DECV_S3601_0, OSD_M36F_0/1, seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)
device.demod: internal ALi M3503 / M3510B DVB-S2 (NIM_S3503_0 at 0xB8028000)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2026 DVB-S2 tuner + ASC RF374 modulator

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (M3510B 1.1.1, 2012-12-20, XIP with CacheAsRam stack at 0x8FFF8000), MemCfg 0x02F000 (00000001), maincode(AV) 0x030000 (20020A882402, LZMA -> 11.91 MB at 0x80000200), seecode 0x3B0000 (M3606 SEE, 2016-11-7, LZMA -> 2.96 MB at 0xA6000200), default_lang 0x4AFD00, cipluskey 0x4AFF80, countryband 0x4C0000, logo_user 0x4C8000, logo_menu 0x4D8000, logo_radio 0x4F8000, logo_boot 0x518000, patch 0x53FF80, defaultdb(PRC) 0x560000, userdb(64+64) 0x73FF80

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Impulse_SAT_2.4.02_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-07.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3503 revision B board (chips/m3503.py, run_dump_impulse_sat_2402_app_starts.py): the XIP bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1") runs from flash using CacheAsRam at 0x8FFF8000..0x8FFFFFFF before relocating to DDR, prints "CH455 panel init OK!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 135 / 134, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA141A7DC, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE", 2.96 MB) and maincode(AV) ("20020A882402", 11.91 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores ("MC: APP  init ok", main EBase 0x80002000, SEE running at 0xA6000200 with EBase 0x86002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and updates the CH455 panel to " on ", initialises hs_config_init and userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its OSD dialog on GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Impulse SAT (System ID 20020A88) EMU firmware v2.4.02 (2016-11-07) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3510B / M3503 rev B SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3510B 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, and an external CH455 4-digit LED / IR sensor eye on GPIO 135 (SCL) / 134 (SDA).
